in_hebrew.name: אריאנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name 'Arianne' can be derived from the Hebrew words 'ארי' (ari) meaning 'mountain' and 'יהוה' (YHVH) meaning 'LORD'. Thus, 'Arianne' can be interpreted as 'Mountain of the LORD'.

in_greek.name: Αριάννη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Arianne' is derived from the Greek word 'Αριάννη' (Arianne), which is composed of the elements 'Αρι' (Ari) meaning 'full' and 'άννη' (annē) meaning 'grace'. Hence, the name 'Arianne' can be interpreted as 'full of grace'.
